research_problem: Preserve artist geometry that is present in the continuous IRIS field without losing it through discretization, surface discovery, contouring, or later simplification.

reason: Eight half-voxel R512 phase evaluations have approximately the same field-query count as one R1024 evaluation.
Phase sensitivity is interpreted primarily as an undersampling/aliasing symptom, not as an independent product solution.
The next causal question is whether continuous-field regions can be certified empty or regular before choosing an adaptive extractor.

cell_states.PROVEN_EMPTY: A conservative interval bound for f(C) excludes zero.
cell_states.PROVEN_REGULAR: A fixed direction d is found for which a conservative bound on D_d f(C) is strictly one-signed over the cell.
cell_states.UNKNOWN: Neither absence nor regular directional behavior is established; subdivision is required or the system abstains at the configured floor.

asymmetric_refinement_rule: Auxiliary source, silhouette, mechanical, uncertainty, or curvature evidence may request additional subdivision but may never certify absence or cancel a safety-required subdivision.

prototype_v1.target_architecture: bilinear triplane -> LayerNorm -> Linear -> SiLU -> Linear -> SiLU -> Linear(sdf)
required_short_tests: SiLU value and derivative interval containment
bilinear triplane value and directional-derivative containment
no sampled zero crossing may be labelled PROVEN_EMPTY
sampled directional derivatives must agree with any emitted PROVEN_REGULAR direction

next_long_experiment.decision_boundary: This run may falsify or support practical certifiability of the current field representation, but cannot mint product authority or select a shipping threshold.
